messages:
Anya: Quick idea  run a 2-week followup pulse pilot to stop actions from drifting. Minimal template, weekly 15m owners-only huddle, bot digest, and a 72h remediation-claim rule. Start next Monday?
Sam: Love it. Keep tooling tiny. I'll wire saved JQL + bot digest.
Jordan: Strong +1 for explicit remediation_owner field. IC != remediation owner by default.
Anya: tiny template (one-line fields):
- action_id: FP-001
- remediation_owner: @Sam
- created_by: @Anya
- created_ts: 2026-04-01
- due_date: 2026-04-08
- priority: P2
- status: open / blocked / done
- validation: 7d post-deploy error rate < 0.1%
- recurrence_flag: true / false
- linked_ticket: https://rwd/jira/FP-001
- notes: one-line blocker
Lee: Add validation_window and a short relationship tag (SLO/billing/customer). Also a tiny triage_rank = priority + recurrence + SLO impact.
Maria: I'll schedule a 15-min owners-only closure huddle Mon 11am for two weeks. Keeps it focused.
Sam: Saved JQL I'll use: `project = FP AND status != Done AND due_date < now()` and I'll hook a weekly digest to #eng-oncall.
Jordan: Metrics for pilot: closure_velocity (actions_closed/week), median_time_to_close, percent_recurrence. I'll build a dashboard.
Anya: Policy: remediation_owner must be claimed within 72h of postmortem publish or auto-escalate to oncall lead.
Sam: Automation plan: incident-bot creates followups from postmortem items, sets owner if present, otherwise marks unassigned and pings #eng-oncall. Low lift.
incident-bot: FYI: 2 followups older than 14 days (FP-020, FP-021).
Lee: When closing an action, add a 1-line "how verified" sentence. Keeps closure objective.
Maria: Calendar invites sent for Mon 11am pilot. Owners get auto-pings when actions are assigned.
Jordan: I'll share a starter dashboard link by Friday.
Sam: I'll post the bot config and saved JQL tomorrow.
Anya: Pilot owners: Sam (automation), Jordan (metrics), Maria (huddle). I'll manage 72h escalation enforcement. Start 2026-04-06, review 2026-04-20.
Lee: If recurrence_flag=true, tag the postmortem and schedule a 30-day pattern review.
Anya: Goal: faster closures, clearer ownership, and earlier detection of recurring patterns. I'll post final template + links in #eng-oncall after updates.
Maria: :white_check_mark:
Sam: :rocket:
incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: followup pulse pilot starts 2026-04-06.
Anya: Closing thread; will reopen with templates/links.)
